title: Long Island Rail Road Strike Shuts Down Busiest US Passenger Rail Service
key_takeaways: The LIRR has set up a limited bus service to help mitigate the impact, but many commuters are still facing long delays and crowded conditions.
The LIRR has been facing significant challenges in recent years, including aging infrastructure and a shortage of skilled workers.
In the meantime, commuters are advised to check the LIRR website for updates and to plan their trips accordingly.
